speaker: SERA
text: Three garrisons heard it. Two stood down. And then the Marshal answered.

speaker: TEAL
text: If I miss your checkout, fly the pattern anyway. The sky will still be there.

speaker: TRAINEE
text: Three bandits on the rim and an empty chair. Fine. I'll fly the pattern.

speaker: RUSK
text: RUSK: You cut one relay. Every loyal pilot still hears me. On me, now.

speaker: VULTURE LEAD
text: VULTURE LEAD: You fly like him. He died anyway. Wing, cut him off.

speaker: VULTURE TWO
text: VULTURE TWO: I taught him that turn. Wing, show the trainee the answer.

speaker: BROADCAST
text: BROADCAST: Convoy, the north corridor is clear. Proceed north at speed.

speaker: LOG
text: VARDA RIM ROSTER. TEAL: KILLED IN ACTION, NOT DESERTED. INSTRUCTOR'S CHAIR: FILLED.

speaker: MARINE
text: MARINE: Witnesses aboard. Keep us covered until parliament is in sight.

speaker: HARBOR
text: HARBOR: Follow the three quay beacons. Our launch needs a clear way out.

speaker: FRIGATE
text: FRIGATE: Follow the outer beacons. Check the whole sea lane is in sight.

speaker: FARMER
text: FARMER: One truck lost its radio. Check both bends for stragglers.

speaker: TRUCK
text: TRUCK: Transmitter rolling. The corridor is full of refugees.

speaker: LOYALIST
text: LOYALIST: Two reply beacons lit. Follow them to check the garrisons.

speaker: LANDING CRAFT
text: LANDING CRAFT: Ramps down. Scan both exits so we can leave the sand.

speaker: TOWER
text: TOWER: Code restored. Stay on the link until every loyal flight answers.

speaker: RECOVERY
text: RECOVERY: Recorder still transmitting. Mark it before the signal dies.
